title: Essential-Spectrum Obstruction for Finite-Shift Dilation Restrictions in Hilbert-Polya Realizations
field: spectral theory and analytic number theory
decided_scope: For every nonzero complex polynomial P with P(1)=0 and no root in the open unit disk, every self-adjoint extension of the dilation generator restricted to P(S)C_c^infinity(0,infinity) has essential spectrum equal to R
open_boundaries: General Hilbert-Polya spectral realizations and the Riemann Hypothesis
